---
title: "A remote site image keeps the size declared on the site"
_quarto:
  render-project: true
  tests:
    html:
      ensureFileRegexMatches:
        -
          - '<meta property="og:image" content="https://images\.example\.com/social\.jpg">'
          - '<meta property="og:image:height" content="630">'
          - '<meta property="og:image:width" content="1200">'
        - []
---

With `site-url` set, Quarto cannot measure a remote image, so the `image-width` and `image-height` declared next to the site image are used.
